name: nginx-multisite
description: Provisions an Nginx frontend for three named sites with static content, virtual-host configuration, and development self-signed TLS certificates. It also applies host hardening controls including Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl, and SSH restrictions.

name: cache
description: Configures local Memcached and Redis services, including Redis authentication and post-processing of generated Redis configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the dibanez/fastapi_tutorial application with a Python virtual environment, dependencies, systemd service, and local PostgreSQL backing database.
